title.en: Treat hallucination as a failure mode, not a personality flaw.
title.zh: 把幻觉当作失效模式，而不是模型性格问题。

subtitle.en: A reliable AI professional turns a vague accuracy complaint into grounded evidence, failure categories, and a remediation path.
subtitle.zh: 可靠的 AI 专业人士，会把模糊的准确性抱怨，转成证据、失效分类和修复路径。

audience: GenAI FDE · AI consultant · Applied AI lead

scenario.customer: The assistant sometimes makes things up. We are not sure whether the model is bad, the retrieval is bad, or the prompts are bad.
scenario.weakResponse: We can add better prompts and use a stronger model.
scenario.reliableResponse: I would not treat this as one generic hallucination problem yet. I would sample failed answers, check whether the required source existed, verify whether retrieval brought it into context, and then separate ungrounded generation from missing context and ambiguous evaluation criteria.

title.en: Use precise nouns to lower emotional temperature.
title.zh: 用精准名词降低问题的情绪温度。

anchor.quote: I would not call it one problem until we know which failure mode we are seeing.

concept.en: Failure mode is calmer than broken. It implies the system can be inspected, categorized, and improved.
concept.zh: Failure mode 比 broken 稳得多。它暗示系统可以被检查、归类、改进。

intent.en: Avoid blaming the model too early.
intent.zh: 避免过早把锅甩给模型。

examples.line: The answer is wrong, but that does not yet tell us whether the failure mode is retrieval, grounding, reasoning, or evaluation.

why.en: You slow the room down and protect the investigation from premature conclusions.
why.zh: 你把会议节奏稳住，避免大家过早下结论。

examples.line: User trust is not an abstract concern here; it depends on whether the answer can be traced back to a source the business accepts.

why.en: Abstract becomes operational: source, traceability, acceptance.
why.zh: 抽象问题变成了操作问题：来源、可追溯、业务可接受。

intent.en: Push for examples without sounding defensive.
intent.zh: 要求失败样本，但不显得防御。

examples.line: A few representative failures will help us be surgical rather than speculative.

why.en: Surgical signals precision; speculative signals unsupported guessing.
why.zh: Surgical 体现精准；speculative 表示没有证据的猜测。

intent.en: Start with a calm diagnostic frame.
intent.zh: 先建立冷静的诊断框架。

lines.line: I would separate this into three layers: whether the source exists, whether retrieval found it, and whether the model used it correctly.

why.en: The customer hears a concrete map instead of a vague promise to improve accuracy.
why.zh: 客户听到的是具体地图，而不是泛泛承诺提高准确率。

intent.en: Treat grounding as a trust contract.
intent.zh: 把 grounding 当作信任契约。

lines.line: For this use case, a good answer is not enough; it needs to be attributable to an approved source.

why.en: Attributable is a strong professional word: it ties correctness to source responsibility.
why.zh: Attributable 是很好的专业词：它把正确性和来源责任连起来。

lines.line: These failures are useful signal. They tell us where the system boundary is today.

why.en: You turn failure into learning without sounding casual about the risk.
why.zh: 你把失败转成学习信号，但没有轻描淡写风险。

lines.line: Prompt changes may help, but I would not make them the first lever until we know the failure distribution.

why.en: You show discipline: fixes should follow distribution, not instinct.
why.zh: 你展示纪律：修复要跟着分布走，而不是跟着直觉走。

lines.line: Once we classify the failures, we can decide whether the fix is better indexing, better retrieval, stricter citation behavior, or a clearer evaluation rubric.

why.en: The sentence converts ambiguity into decision branches.
why.zh: 这句话把不确定转成了决策分支。

prompt.en: Practice diagnosing accuracy issues without sounding reactive.
prompt.zh: 练习在准确性问题上保持诊断姿态，而不是被动反应。

steps.en: The answer is correct but cannot cite a source.
steps.zh: 答案是对的，但无法引用来源。

focus.en: Use attributable and approved source to explain why correctness alone is insufficient.
focus.zh: 用 attributable 和 approved source 说明为什么仅仅正确还不够。

steps.zh: 检索找到了不相关文档。

focus.en: Separate retrieval quality from model reasoning.
focus.zh: 把检索质量和模型推理拆开。

steps.en: The business team says users have lost trust.
steps.zh: 业务团队说用户已经失去信任。

focus.en: Translate trust into traceability, repeatability, and accepted sources.
focus.zh: 把 trust 翻译成可追溯、可重复、来源被认可。
